method: Searched the web for each site (a fetch of the sites themselves fails from the builder's network), so features come from search results, vendor pages and third-party reviews; paid tiers and limits change often, confirm before any price claim.

features.name: Several boards
features.detail: Make as many boards as you need and switch between them; free plans cap the count.
features.verse_evidence: Boards select, New board with four templates, rename, delete (pages /kanban/, /kanban/teams/, /kanban/flow/)

features.name: Columns (lists) you name, add, move and delete
features.detail: The stages a card moves through.
features.verse_evidence: add, rename, move left/right, delete (cards go to the archive)

features.name: Cards with title and description
features.detail: A card holds a title, text and details.
features.verse_evidence: title, notes, labels, due, checklist, comments, assignee, colour, repeat, time

features.name: Drag and drop cards between columns
features.detail: Move a card with the pointer, reorder inside a column.
features.verse_evidence: mouse drag, touch drag from the grip, Move to menu

features.name: Keyboard shortcuts and keyboard moves
features.detail: Move and open cards without a mouse.
features.verse_evidence: Alt+arrow moves a focused card; Enter opens it; Escape closes

features.name: Coloured labels
features.detail: Tag cards with named colours and filter by them.
features.verse_evidence: six coloured labels per board, make more, filter by label

features.name: Due dates
features.detail: A due date on a card, shown as overdue or due soon.
features.verse_evidence: date per card, overdue/today/soon marks, filter by due

features.name: Checklists with progress
features.detail: Subtask lists inside a card with a progress bar.
features.verse_evidence: checklist with progress bar

features.name: Members and assignees
features.detail: Share a board and give cards to people.
features.verse_evidence: a name typed per card (no accounts, so no sharing between people); filter by it via swimlanes

features.name: Comments and activity log
features.detail: Discuss on a card; see who did what.
features.verse_evidence: dated comments on a card, searched by the filter

features.name: Attachments and card covers
features.detail: Files or images on a card.
features.verse_evidence: a colour per card; no file attachments (nothing is stored but text)

features.name: Search and filter
features.detail: Find cards by words, label, date or member.
features.verse_evidence: search box, label, due date

features.name: Archive cards and columns
features.detail: Hide finished work without deleting it.
features.verse_evidence: archive a card, restore it, delete it for good

features.name: Import and export (JSON, CSV)
features.detail: Take a board out as a file, or bring one in (Trello JSON among them).
features.verse_evidence: JSON and CSV export; import this page's JSON and a Trello board export

features.name: Calendar, timeline, table views
features.detail: The same cards as a calendar, a roadmap or a table.
features.verse_evidence: not built: calendar, timeline and table views (the Calendar page shows dates)

features.name: Automation (rules, buttons)
features.detail: When X happens, do Y; run daily or weekly.
features.verse_evidence: skipped: rules need a server to run when the page is shut; repeating cards cover the common case

features.name: Recurring cards
features.detail: A card that comes back on a schedule.
features.verse_evidence: repeat daily, weekly or monthly: a fresh copy waits in the first column when it reaches the last

features.name: Board and card templates
features.detail: Start from a ready board.
features.verse_evidence: four starting boards: To do/Doing/Done, Backlog to Done, a week, empty

features.name: Power-ups and integrations
features.detail: Slack, Drive, GitHub and more.
features.verse_evidence: skipped: integrations need accounts and servers

features.name: Share a board by link
features.detail: A link that opens the board for others.
features.verse_evidence: Share by link: the whole board in the link's # part, never sent to a server (small boards)

features.detail: Pick a background or a dark theme.
features.verse_evidence: follows the device's dark mode; no board backgrounds
